## Related work

Link the issue or agreed proposal. Use `Fixes #123` only when this PR resolves it. For a small standalone correction, state the problem here. Add T/R/AT references when applicable.

## Change

What was wrong, what changes for the user, and why does this fix it? Keep this brief and describe the parts you understand; call out uncertainty for the reviewer.

## Verification

Give the command or reproduction steps, OS, fixture/live mode, and actual result. Include failures and untested cases. Link detailed evidence instead of pasting long logs or agent transcripts.

## UI evidence (if applicable)

Show the same state before and after at relevant desktop/mobile sizes. For a non-UI change, remove this section.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff, can explain the change, and removed unrelated edits.
- [ ] I included reproducible verification and disclosed any remaining uncertainty.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, browser profiles, or runtime databases are included.
- [ ] Applicable docs, acceptance evidence, lockfile, and attribution are updated.
